title: Private Idol Disc Vol. 2: Miki Uchiyama
native_title: プラドル ＤＩＳＣ Ｖｏｌ．２ ～内山美紀～
overview:
Miki Uchiyama

An idol for you, and only for you - yes, a Private Idol!

Volume 2 of the Private Idol Disc series is a digital photo book starring Miki Uchiyama, offering a look at her you will not find on TV. In the Photo Hall you choose the pictures you want from outdoor, studio and private shoots, and in the Video Hall you watch short movies in which she introduces herself.

- Photo Hall: outdoor, studio and private photo sets
- Video Hall: short video clips
- Bonus: a "look this way" mini game
- Preview of the next volume and production credits
